new_sources.summary: This chapter explores how AI-powered systems used in workplace settings can either uphold or undermine human dignity depending on how they are designed. Drawing from frameworks such as Human-Centered Design, Value-Sensitive Design, and Responsible Innovation, the chapter offers practical strategies for ethical design decisions. It includes real-world insights from the development of Arsent, a compliance tool, and highlights how interface choices shape emotional experience, trust, and regulatory alignment. The chapter emphasizes that ethical design in enterprise systems must go beyond technical functionality to address how systems are perceived, interpreted, and felt by users.
